scope: Source-audit consistency across compiler-reported transitive inputs. Reliability prerequisite for future audit reuse, not an implemented cache or a speedup claim.

implementation.discovery: Compiler -M resolves each translation unit's dependency graph with the same configured compiler, include paths, defines and target flags as its AST/preprocessor commands.
implementation.snapshots: Shared immutable byte snapshots include system and transitive headers. Explicit manifest source snapshots still bind AST offsets to their original source text.
implementation.checks: Check observed bytes before and after compiler passes, compare the macro pass's -MD graph, then re-resolve every translation unit's graph and check bytes again before publication. The final graph check covers newly appearing __has_include targets affecting earlier completed units.
implementation.resources: Existing one-to-four-worker limit and single retained AST projection remain. Dependency sidecars use privately created temporary directories with RAII cleanup.
implementation.coverage: Dependency inclusion does not automatically grant audit coverage; included sources still require explicit manifest ownership.
implementation.parser: Fixed Make target; escaped spaces, tabs, hashes, doubled dollars, LF/CRLF continuations. Reject unsupported backslash escapes, variable expansion, malformed or empty records. No general arbitrary-filename Make parser claim.

tests.mutation_cases: Eight transitive/header-appearance cases across one and two workers, in addition to eight existing explicit-source mutation cases. The earlier-TU appearance fixture synchronizes on completed preprocessing rather than depending on worker scheduling.
tests.transport: Updated simulated compilers emit dependency records without bypassing malformed AST, preprocessing failure, source-offset, timeout or dynamic queue checks.
tests.parser_cases: Filename identity with spaces/hash/dollar; LF and CRLF adjacent-token continuation; wrong target, empty dependencies, variable expansion, unsupported and truncated escapes.
tests.integrated_scope: Final production parser/guard and transport fixtures; before the last test-only synchronization change and public API documentation comment.

full_manifest_control.final_scope: Final production dependency parser/guard; cmp against the preserved control exits zero, with the same census SHA256 and counts. No builds/tests overlapped this final run. OS cache uncontrolled; the control run had contention, so this still is not a matched performance comparison.
full_manifest_control.timing_caveat: Builds/tests overlapped parts of the initial comparison. These are correctness runs, not a controlled speed comparison. No performance attribution or Python comparison.

limitations: Observed consistency is not an atomic filesystem snapshot: changes restored between observations and changes after the final check remain possible.
Compiler binaries, effective toolchain/environment and dynamic inputs are not fully fingerprinted. These checks are not sufficient as a persistent cache key.
Extra dependency discovery and byte checks can add cost; no claim of audit speed improvement.
Census equality is not complete board qualification. This batch does not change placement algorithms, hardware requirements or board acceptance gates.
Full goal outcomes, including matched both-board Python timing comparisons, remain incomplete.
